Up. 7. 23. 1</ls>; <ls>Bhāg. 5. 18. 30</ls>. --{%n.%} .²1 The earth. .²2 A territory, district, piece of ground. .²3 A being, creature. .²4 Plurality (of number); आपः स्त्रीभूम्नि <ls>Ak.</ls>; <ab>cf.</ab> पुंभूमन्.
